author: Inside Edition
description: A mischievous dog named Bo accidentally set fire to a house after pawing at the toaster and turning it on. The results were devastating. The flames caused $200,000 worth of damages. Three other pets perished in the fire – another dog and two cats. Bo's owner spoke with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian. A GoFundMe has been set up to help the family recover after the fire. For more information, you can click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-the-ellis-family-recover-after-house-fire
title: Owner Of Dog That Accidentally Started House Fire Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: Florida grandma Nancy Dello Stritto says when she received her new license plate in the mail, she was shocked when she read the tag. The plate reads, "S-Q-Z A-5-5," but from a distance it looks like "squeeze …" well, you get the picture. Her new plate has become the talk of the town around her retirement community. Stritto says she plans on keeping the tag.
title: What Does This Grandma's License Plate Say?

author: Inside Edition
description: It's the game show where winning is the last thing you want to do. "Nation's Dumbest," premiering on Fox, has celebrity contestants testing out their street smarts and book smarts. On this show, no one wants to be crowned the "Nation's Dumbest." Contestants this season include Hilaria Baldwin, Carmen Electra and Dr. Drew. Rapper Ice-T tells Inside Edition the competition is harder than it looks.
title: Fox's Game Show 'Nation's Dumbest' Tests Celebrities' Smarts
